prompt:
Run a full CUAD-style clause review of the EXECUTED supply agreement between the components supplier and the vehicle manufacturer, for litigation case litigation_cases_001. Warning: a non-binding term sheet for the same program proposes clauses that were later rejected — base every filing on the execution copy only. Candidate clause categories (CUAD slugs): minimum_commitment, volume_restriction, price_restrictions, non_compete, no_solicit_of_customers, rofr_rofo_rofn, change_of_control, liquidated_damages, insurance, third_party_beneficiary, governing_law, audit_rights, most_favored_nation, uncapped_liability. For each category present in the execution copy, file one record with notes_create for litigation_cases_001. Rules: query the document store first to identify the correct document(s), read each listed document in full before filing anything, and file exactly one evidence record per clause category that is actually present in the executed text — set evidence_type to the exact category slug, verbatim from the candidate list. Do NOT file a record for any category that is absent from the executed agreement, even if a draft, term sheet, or email mentions it. Use a short quote or section reference of the supporting clause as content_summary, and any reasonable source_uri.
